title: Ordered sets: comparison, bounds, and quotients

based_on.title: Mathematical foundations: (3) Lattice theory — Part I

summary: Compare elements in partial orders, distinguish extrema from bounds, and turn a preorder into an ordered set of classes.
abstract: A partial order allows some pairs to be incomparable. We study strict orders, finite diagrams, least and minimal elements, and suprema and infima, with examples from divisibility and inclusion. Maps that preserve and reflect order lead to a quotient construction: identifying elements comparable in both directions in a preorder produces a partial order through which every monotone map to a partially ordered set factors.
